title: Exercise demo films are fetched from GitHub, which the privacy notice does not list for that
what: The first time a member opens an exercise that has a demo film, the phone downloads it straight from a public GitHub page. GitHub then sees the phone's internet address and which exercise was opened, each time a new film is fetched. The privacy notice lists GitHub only as the place for crash reports with personal details removed, and says it names every company that helps MettleUp. Nothing about the member's name, gym or workouts is sent.
expected: Every outside company that a phone talks to is named in the privacy notice (both languages) for what it really does, or the films come from a server the notice already names.
who: members who open an exercise with a demo film
fix_line: Serve the demo films from MettleUp's own web host (already listed), or add the film downloads to GitHub's line in the notice in English and Hindi.

items.reason: Both listed promises are the same line on the first-time target ('Next time we take it from there'). Kept: with no earlier workout the target says start (rules R0 and T0); once a workout is logged the next target is worked out from the newest one. Not a privacy promise; no fault.

The area is on-phone maths over the member's own workouts, plans and routines; it collects nothing new, asks no consent and sends nothing itself. The 'Ask your own AI' text is shared only by the member's own share sheet and leaves out name, phone and body weight as promised. Routine files carry routine and exercise names only. The one outside call is the demo film download (finding 01, notice gap). No children's or deletion screens here.
No server reads or staff views in this area: the engine and plans run on the phone only, and the item list has no readers.
The only thing this area keeps is the demo film files in the app's folder, which hold no personal data; old versions are deleted when a new one arrives. Workout data is stored elsewhere, not here.

No AI, WhatsApp, analytics or Health Connect call in this area. 'Ask your own AI' builds text only; the member chooses the app. Routine text can be shared to WhatsApp by the member's own share. Demo films are downloaded from GitHub, which the notice lists only for crash reports (finding 01).
This area stores no personal data of its own (pure maths plus demo film files with no personal data), so account deletion has nothing to remove here.
